entwurf.thema: Automating Quantitative Investment Research with Qlib

teile.text: Quantitative research needs a consistent pipeline, and Microsoft Qlib provides the platform to build one.
It supports supervised learning to mine market patterns and reinforcement learning to model your trading decisions.
Qlib covers the entire quantitative investment chain, from initial data processing to your final model back-testing.
The platform includes RD-Agent to autonomously handle factor mining and joint optimization of your various models.

teile.text: When loading saved artifacts, remember to verify storage permissions or use trusted settings for safer processing.

entwurf.beschreibung: Microsoft Qlib provides an AI-oriented platform for quantitative investment research, supporting supervised learning and model back-testing. Use the integrated RD-Agent for autonomous factor mining and model optimization.
